about.title: Your community arborists
paragraphs: Chandler Tree is owned by Graham Chandler and based in Corbett, Oregon.

Our mission is to bring expert tree care that protects your home, enhances your landscape and adds lasting value. From precision pruning to safe removals, our crew delivers top-tier results with the care your property deserves.
It's not just about cutting costs. It's about doing the job right, and we stay in constant communication with you until the job is done.

estimate.title: Tell us about your trees.
estimate.text: Send us a few details and we'll get back to you with a free quote.
estimate.thanks: We got your request and will reach out soon about your free quote.

services.name: Tree Removal
services.blurb: Safe removal of dead, dying and unwanted trees, big or small.
services.intro: When a tree has to come down, we take it down safely and protect your home, driveway and landscape along the way.
photos: Cutting a tree with a chainsaw

services.name: Tree Pruning
services.blurb: Precision pruning for healthier, safer, better-looking trees.
services.intro: Good pruning keeps trees healthy, clears branches away from your roof and lines, and lets more light into your yard.
includes: Clearing branches from roofs and lines

services.name: Stump Grinding
services.blurb: Grind stumps below grade so you can reclaim your yard.
services.intro: We grind stumps down so you can mow, plant or build where the tree used to be.

services.name: Chipping & Debris Removal
services.blurb: Limbs chipped and debris hauled so your yard is left clean.
services.intro: We chip limbs and haul away debris, so all you're left with is a clean yard.
includes: A clean yard when we leave

services.name: Hazard Tree Assessment
services.blurb: Find out if a leaning or damaged tree is a risk before it fails.
services.intro: Leaning, cracked or rotting trees near your home can fail in winter ice and wind. We'll look them over and tell you honestly what needs to happen.
photos: Old tree with a hollow trunk
